from pathlib import Path
import time,json,sys,os,hashlib
out=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); binary=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(); deadline=time.monotonic()+900
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); snapshots=out/'snapshots'; snapshots.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
epoch=None; saved={}; ended=False
while time.monotonic()<deadline:
 if epoch is None:
  for proc in Path('/proc').glob('[0-9]*'):
   try:
    if Path(os.readlink(proc/'exe')).resolve()!=binary:continue
    args=(proc/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
    if str(out/'config').encode() not in args:continue
    stat=(proc/'stat').read_text();fields=stat[stat.rfind(')')+2:].split()
    epoch={'pid':int(proc.name),'start_ticks':int(fields[19]),'clock_ticks_per_second':os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK'),'boot_id':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),'command':[a.decode() for a in args if a],'executable_sha256':sha(binary.read_bytes())}
    (out/'process-epoch.json').write_text(json.dumps(epoch,indent=2)+'\n')
    env=dict(x.split(b'=',1) for x in (proc/'environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if b'=' in x)
    keep=['ASAN_OPTIONS','UBSAN_OPTIONS','SDL_VIDEODRIVER','LD_PRELOAD','LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE','OPENMW_M15_RUN_ID','OPENMW_M15_EPOCH']
    (out/'actual-engine-environment.json').write_text(json.dumps({k:env[k.encode()].decode() for k in keep if k.encode() in env},indent=2)+'\n')
   except (FileNotFoundError,PermissionError,ProcessLookupError):continue
 events=out/'events.jsonl'
 if events.exists():
  for line in events.read_text().splitlines():
   try:e=json.loads(line)
   except json.JSONDecodeError:continue
   if e['event']=='save-complete' and e['sequence'] not in saved:
    src=Path(e['save']); blob=src.read_bytes()
    if sha(blob)!=e['save_sha256']:raise RuntimeError('save overwritten before snapshot: '+str(e['sequence']))
    live=out/e['live']; assert sha(live.read_bytes())==e['live_sha256']
    target=snapshots/f"save-{e['sequence']}.omwsave"
    with target.open('xb') as f:f.write(blob)
    saved[e['sequence']]={'event':e,'snapshot':str(target),'sha256':sha(blob)}
    (out/'snapshot-index.json').write_text(json.dumps(saved,indent=2)+'\n')
   if e['event']=='run-end':ended=True
 if ended:break
 time.sleep(.02)
assert epoch and ended and saved, (epoch,ended,saved)
print(json.dumps({'epoch':epoch,'snapshots':list(saved),'run_end':ended},indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import copy, hashlib, json, struct, sys
from scripts.tes4_runtime_state import load_save, encode_payload, _find_runtime_record
base=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); player='dynamic:player:0000000000000001'; npc='content:oblivion.esm:01fc43'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
fetch=lambda s,k,a=player:next(x for x in s[k] if x['actor']==a)
original=load_save(base/'staged-input.omwsave')
assert json.loads((base/'extra-content-reference-audit.json').read_text())['passed']
assert original['schema_version']==53
assert original['combat_rng_state']==505908858
expected_rng=original['combat_rng_state']
for _ in range(2):expected_rng=(expected_rng*214013+2531011)&0xffffffff
assert expected_rng==159719620
initial_sword=next(x for x in original['player']['inventory'] if x['base']=='content:oblivion.esm:090615')
assert initial_sword['condition']==1.000100016593933 and initial_sword['count']==1 and initial_sword['equipped_slots']==65536
reports=[];epochs=[];first_state=None;first_held=None
for phase in ['first','second']:
 out=base/phase
 if not (out/'launcher.json').exists():break
 launcher=json.loads((out/'launcher.json').read_text());assert launcher['scenario_returncode']==launcher['monitor_returncode']==0
 assert json.loads((out/'scenario.json').read_text())['passed']
 epoch=json.loads((out/'process-epoch.json').read_text());epochs.append(epoch)
 pin=json.loads((base/'binary-pin.json').read_text())
 assert epoch['executable_sha256']==pin['sha256']==launcher['binary_sha256']
 if 'm15-sanitize' in pin['path']:
  env=json.loads((out/'actual-engine-environment.json').read_text())
  assert env['ASAN_OPTIONS']=='detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1'
  assert env['UBSAN_OPTIONS']=='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1'
  assert env['LD_PRELOAD'].split(':')[0]=='/usr/lib64/libasan.so.8.0.0'
 events=[json.loads(x) for x in (out/'events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
 assert all(x['pid']==epoch['pid'] for x in events)
 assert events[0]['event']=='run-start' and events[-1]['event']=='run-end'
 pristine=out/'input-pristine.omwsave';initial=load_save(pristine)
 load=next(x for x in events if x['event']=='load-complete');assert load['save_sha256']==sha(pristine.read_bytes())
 load_blob=(out/load['live']).read_bytes();assert sha(load_blob)==load['live_sha256'];loaded=json.loads(load_blob)
 if phase=='first':assert pristine.read_bytes()==(base/'staged-input.omwsave').read_bytes()
 else:
  idx=json.loads((base/'first/snapshot-index.json').read_text());assert sha(pristine.read_bytes())==idx[max(idx,key=int)]['sha256']
  candidate=copy.deepcopy(initial)
  for key in ['native_melee_states','native_animation_clocks']:
   candidate[key]=[copy.deepcopy(fetch(loaded,key)) if x['actor']==player else x for x in candidate[key]]
  assert encode_payload(candidate)==encode_payload(initial), 'Player cache and clocks must load bit-exact'
 idx=json.loads((out/'snapshot-index.json').read_text());assert len(idx)==(1 if phase=='first' else 2)
 checks=[]
 for sequence,row in sorted(idx.items(),key=lambda kv:int(kv[0])):
  blob=Path(row['snapshot']).read_bytes();assert sha(blob)==row['sha256']==row['event']['save_sha256']
  live=(out/row['event']['live']).read_bytes();assert sha(live)==row['event']['live_sha256']
  state=load_save(Path(row['snapshot']));assert _find_runtime_record(blob)[3]==encode_payload(state)==encode_payload(json.loads(live))
  assert state['schema_version']==61
  assert state['next_dynamic_serial']==original['next_dynamic_serial']
  assert state['native_loose_weapons']==original['native_loose_weapons']==[]
  assert [x for x in state['references'] if x['key'].startswith('dynamic:')]==[x for x in original['references'] if x['key'].startswith('dynamic:')]
  assert state['physical_actions']=={'next':3,'pending':[]} and state['physical_action_owners']==[]
  assert state['combat_rng_state']==expected_rng
  assert state['native_actor_life']==original['native_actor_life']
  for av in state['native_actor_values']:
   before=fetch(original,'native_actor_values',av['actor'])
   for index,(old,new) in enumerate(zip(before['values'],av['values'])):
    if index==10 and av['actor'] in (player,npc):
     assert old[:3]==new[:3] and -(20.025 if av['actor']==player else 7.8)-.0001 <= new[3] <= 0
    elif index==8 and av['actor']==player:
     assert old[:3]==new[:3] and struct.pack('<f',-new[3])==struct.pack('<I',1065087140)
    else:assert old==new,(av['actor'],index,old,new)
  inv=copy.deepcopy(original['player']['inventory']);sword=next(x for x in inv if x['base']=='content:oblivion.esm:090615');sword['condition']=0.;sword['equipped_slots']=0
  assert state['player']['inventory']==inv
  oldrefs={x['key']:copy.deepcopy(x['inventory']) for x in original['references'] if x['inventory']}
  refs={x['key']:x['inventory'] for x in state['references'] if x['key'] in oldrefs}
  for key,items in refs.items():
   for item in items:
    matching=[x for x in oldrefs[key] if x['base']==item['base']]
    assert len(matching)==1
    expected=matching[0]
    if key==npc and item['base']=='content:oblivion.esm:090615':expected['condition']=55.70000076293945
  assert refs==oldrefs
  m=fetch(state,'native_melee_states');assert m['strike'] is None and m['reaction'] is None
  views=[('body',m['held_blocks']),('first',m['first_person']['held_blocks'])]
  windup=phase=='first' or sequence==min(idx,key=int)
  held=[(view,h) for view,cache in views for h in cache]
  assert held and all(h['animation_group']=='onehandblockidle' for _,h in held)
  if windup:
   assert fetch(state,'native_actor_values')['process_action']==6
   for view,h in held:
    assert not h['inactive'] and h['retirement'] is None and h['sequence_timing']['easing']
    assert h['pose_snapshot'] and h['pose_snapshot']['tracks'] and h['pose_snapshot']['destination_frame']==0
    assert h['animation_time']==h['sequence_timing']['output_time']==0
    assert abs(h['sequence_timing']['ease_end']-h['sequence_timing']['ease_start']-8)<.00001
   if phase=='first':first_held=copy.deepcopy(held);first_state=state
   else:assert [(v,h['pose_snapshot']) for v,h in held]==[(v,h['pose_snapshot']) for v,h in first_held]
  else:
   assert fetch(state,'native_actor_values')['process_action']==-1
   assert any(h['retirement'] and h['retirement']['duration']==8 and not h['sequence_timing']['easing'] for _,h in held)
   assert state['combat_rng_state']==first_state['combat_rng_state']
   for view,h in held:
    old=next(old for old_view,old in first_held if old_view==view)
    if h['retirement']:
     assert h['retirement']['start_clock']>=old['sequence_timing']['ease_end'], 'release must wait for captured windup completion'
  checks.append(dict(sequence=sequence,wire_exact=True,phase='NI5' if windup else 'NI3',held=[dict(view=v,group=h['animation_group'],pose_tracks=len(h['pose_snapshot']['tracks']) if h['pose_snapshot'] else 0,inactive=h['inactive'],retirement=h['retirement']) for v,h in held]))
 log=(out/'process.log').read_text()
 assert all(x not in log for x in ['ERROR: AddressSanitizer','runtime error:','Error in frame','onFrame failed'])
 assert log.count('M15 melee hit committed:')==(1 if phase=='first' else 0)
 assert log.count('M15 block begin: actor='+player)==(1 if phase=='first' else 0)
 assert log.count('M15 block release: actor='+player)==(0 if phase=='first' else 1)
 assert 'group=handtohandblockidle' not in log
 reports.append(dict(phase=phase,pid=epoch['pid'],binary_sha256=epoch['executable_sha256'],saves=checks,one_contact_no_replay=True,retained_broken_sword=True))
if len(epochs)==2:assert (epochs[0]['pid'],epochs[0]['start_ticks'])!=(epochs[1]['pid'],epochs[1]['start_ticks'])
report=dict(passed=len(reports)==2,scope='Player selected view normal NPC weapon break during NI5, cache/clock load preservation and subsequent NI3 release',phases=reports,full_M15S4_acceptance=False)
(base/'runtime-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,zlib,struct,sys,math
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5];sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from scripts.tes4_runtime_state import load_save
p=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve() if len(sys.argv)>1 else Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source=load_save(p/'staged-input.omwsave');original={v['key'] for v in source['references']}
states=[load_save(p/phase/'userdata/saves/M15Review/Quicksave.omwsave') for phase in ('first','second')]
extras=[{v['key']:v for v in s['references'] if v['key'] not in original and not v['key'].startswith('dynamic:')} for s in states]
wanted=set().union(*(set(int(k.rsplit(':',1)[1],16) for k in group) for group in extras))
master=Path('/home/maciek/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Oblivion/Data/Oblivion.esm');data=master.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()=='a26e21ea8c3041f8737ffb3a266129dedb7f8a88590625ecfecd5eb7f66b4a70'
found={};cells={}
def walk(start,end,cell=None,world=None):
 pos=start
 while pos<end:
  tag=data[pos:pos+4];size=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,pos+4)[0]
  if tag==b'GRUP':
   label,typ=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,pos+8);walk(pos+20,pos+size,label if typ==6 else cell,label if typ==1 else world);pos+=size;continue
  flags,form=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,pos+8)
  if tag==b'CELL' or (form in wanted and tag in (b'REFR',b'ACHR',b'ACRE')):
   body=data[pos+20:pos+20+size]
   if flags&0x40000:
    length=struct.unpack_from('<I',body)[0];body=zlib.decompress(body[4:]);assert len(body)==length
   q=0;fields={};extended=None
   while q<len(body):
    st=body[q:q+4];n=struct.unpack_from('<H',body,q+4)[0];q+=6
    if st==b'XXXX':extended=struct.unpack_from('<I',body,q)[0];q+=n;continue
    if extended is not None:n=extended;extended=None
    fields[st]=body[q:q+n];q+=n
   assert q==len(body)
   if tag==b'CELL':
    cells[form]={'world':world,'flags':flags,'interior':bool(fields[b'DATA'][0]&1),'coordinates':struct.unpack('<ii',fields[b'XCLC'][:8]) if b'XCLC' in fields else None}
   else:
    assert cell is not None
    found[form]={'base':struct.unpack('<I',fields[b'NAME'])[0],'cell':cell,'world':world,'flags':flags,'tag':tag.decode(),'position':struct.unpack('<6f',fields[b'DATA'])}
  pos+=20+size
 assert pos==end
walk(0,len(data));assert found.keys()==wanted
rows=[];resolved=[]
for phase,group in zip(('first','second'),extras):
 for key,ref in group.items():
  assert key.startswith('content:oblivion.esm:')
  native=found[int(key.rsplit(':',1)[1],16)]
  assert ref['base']==f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['base']:06x}"
  if ref['cell']!=f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['cell']:06x}":
   assert native['tag']=='REFR' and native['flags']&0x400
   parent=cells[native['cell']];assert parent['flags']&0x400 and not parent['interior']
   assert ref['cell'].startswith('content:oblivion.esm:')
   target_id=int(ref['cell'].rsplit(':',1)[1],16);target=cells[target_id]
   assert native['world'] is not None and parent['world']==native['world']==target['world']
   assert not target['interior'] and not target['flags']&0x400
   assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in native['position'])
   assert ref['position'][:3]==list(native['position'][:3])
   physical_cell=tuple(math.floor(v/4096) for v in native['position'][:2]);assert target['coordinates']==physical_cell
   resolved.append({'phase':phase,'reference':key,'base':ref['base'],'world':f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['world']:06x}",'persistent_storage_cell':f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['cell']:06x}",'saved_physical_cell':ref['cell'],'coordinates':physical_cell,'unchanged_master_position':native['position'][:3]})
 rows.append({'count':len(group),'identity_base_cell_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted((k,r['base'],r['cell']) for k,r in group.items()),separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()})
r={'passed':True,'master_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'counts':rows,'persistent_exterior_references':resolved,'scope':'Every added content reference has original master identity/base and parent CELL, or independently verified persistent exterior storage: original unchanged position resolves by floor(x/4096),floor(y/4096) to saved physical CELL in the same original worldspace. Both REFR and parent CELL must carry Persistent; target CELL must be nonpersistent exterior. Exactly one dynamic native-reference is checked separately. No unchanged whole-world cache-size claim.'}
(p/'extra-content-reference-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r))

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,zlib,struct,sys,math
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5];sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from scripts.tes4_runtime_state import load_save
p=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve() if len(sys.argv)>1 else Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source=load_save(p/'staged-input.omwsave');original={v['key'] for v in source['references']}
states=[load_save(p/phase/'userdata/saves/M15Review/Quicksave.omwsave') for phase in ('first','second')]
extras=[{v['key']:v for v in s['references'] if v['key'] not in original and not v['key'].startswith('dynamic:')} for s in states]
wanted=set().union(*(set(int(k.rsplit(':',1)[1],16) for k in group) for group in extras))
master=Path('/home/maciek/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Oblivion/Data/Oblivion.esm');data=master.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()=='a26e21ea8c3041f8737ffb3a266129dedb7f8a88590625ecfecd5eb7f66b4a70'
found={};cells={}
def walk(start,end,cell=None,world=None):
 pos=start
 while pos<end:
  tag=data[pos:pos+4];size=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,pos+4)[0]
  if tag==b'GRUP':
   label,typ=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,pos+8);walk(pos+20,pos+size,label if typ==6 else cell,label if typ==1 else world);pos+=size;continue
  flags,form=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,pos+8)
  if tag==b'CELL' or (form in wanted and tag in (b'REFR',b'ACHR',b'ACRE')):
   body=data[pos+20:pos+20+size]
   if flags&0x40000:
    length=struct.unpack_from('<I',body)[0];body=zlib.decompress(body[4:]);assert len(body)==length
   q=0;fields={};extended=None
   while q<len(body):
    st=body[q:q+4];n=struct.unpack_from('<H',body,q+4)[0];q+=6
    if st==b'XXXX':extended=struct.unpack_from('<I',body,q)[0];q+=n;continue
    if extended is not None:n=extended;extended=None
    fields[st]=body[q:q+n];q+=n
   assert q==len(body)
   if tag==b'CELL':
    cells[form]={'world':world,'flags':flags,'interior':bool(fields[b'DATA'][0]&1),'coordinates':struct.unpack('<ii',fields[b'XCLC'][:8]) if b'XCLC' in fields else None}
   else:
    assert cell is not None
    found[form]={'base':struct.unpack('<I',fields[b'NAME'])[0],'cell':cell,'world':world,'flags':flags,'tag':tag.decode(),'position':struct.unpack('<6f',fields[b'DATA'])}
  pos+=20+size
 assert pos==end
walk(0,len(data));assert found.keys()==wanted
rows=[];resolved=[]
for phase,group in zip(('first','second'),extras):
 for key,ref in group.items():
  assert key.startswith('content:oblivion.esm:')
  native=found[int(key.rsplit(':',1)[1],16)]
  assert ref['base']==f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['base']:06x}"
  if ref['cell']!=f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['cell']:06x}":
   assert native['tag']=='REFR' and native['flags']&0x400
   parent=cells[native['cell']];assert parent['flags']&0x400 and not parent['interior']
   assert ref['cell'].startswith('content:oblivion.esm:')
   target_id=int(ref['cell'].rsplit(':',1)[1],16);target=cells[target_id]
   assert native['world'] is not None and parent['world']==native['world']==target['world']
   assert not target['interior'] and not target['flags']&0x400
   assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in native['position'])
   assert ref['position'][:3]==list(native['position'][:3])
   physical_cell=tuple(math.floor(v/4096) for v in native['position'][:2]);assert target['coordinates']==physical_cell
   resolved.append({'phase':phase,'reference':key,'base':ref['base'],'world':f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['world']:06x}",'persistent_storage_cell':f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['cell']:06x}",'saved_physical_cell':ref['cell'],'coordinates':physical_cell,'unchanged_master_position':native['position'][:3]})
 rows.append({'count':len(group),'identity_base_cell_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted((k,r['base'],r['cell']) for k,r in group.items()),separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()})
r={'passed':True,'master_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'counts':rows,'persistent_exterior_references':resolved,'scope':'Every added content reference has original master identity/base and parent CELL, or independently verified persistent exterior storage: original unchanged position resolves by floor(x/4096),floor(y/4096) to saved physical CELL in the same original worldspace. Both REFR and parent CELL must carry Persistent; target CELL must be nonpersistent exterior. Exactly one dynamic native-reference is checked separately. No unchanged whole-world cache-size claim.'}
(p/'extra-content-reference-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r))
